checkin.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
checkin.a: Times are being confirmed with the family. Tell us when you'll arrive and we'll plan around you.

id.q: Do I need to bring ID?
id.a: Yes. Carry a government-issued photo ID for every adult guest. This is standard for lodgings in India.

lift.a: Yes. The building has lift access to every floor.

security.a: The building runs 24/7 CCTV surveillance. Ask about gate and reception hours when you arrive.

parking.a: Parking is not confirmed yet. Two-wheelers are common here; please call ahead about cars.

groups.q: Can we book for a group?
groups.a: Family and pilgrim groups are welcome. Call ahead so rooms can be held together.

cta.title: A lamp is lit.
cta.body: Send the dates and we'll reply with what's open, what it costs, and how to reach us.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This site is built to collect as little as possible. Here is exactly what happens to your information.

forms.title: Enquiry form
forms.body: Your enquiry opens as a prefilled WhatsApp draft addressed to the lodge; review it and choose whether to send. If WhatsApp is unavailable, the connected enquiry form may use Formspree. We use submitted details only to respond and do not sell them.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: Analytics is off by default, and the site sets no cookies unless analytics is switched on. If it is enabled, the provider is named in the site's configuration.

maps.title: Maps
maps.body: The map is an embedded Google Maps frame. Google may set its own cookies when it loads. Opening the map in a new tab is also available.

contact.title: Contacting us
contact.body: To ask about or remove your data, contact the lodge directly using the details on the Contact page.
